errors.text_span: за България стойностите преди трансфери са между 43.2 и 44.1, а след трансфери са между 39.6 и 40.8
errors.evidence: The stated ranges for Bulgaria are incorrect. The values for Bulgaria before transfers (grey bars) range from 40.3 (in 2016) to 44.1 (in 2019), not from 43.2. The values for Bulgaria after transfers (yellow bars) range from 37.7 (in 2016) to 40.8 (in 2019), not from 39.6.

The term 'significantly higher' ('значително по-високи') is a subjective interpretation, not a direct description of the visual data. While the values for Bulgaria are visibly higher than for the EU, 'significantly' adds an analytical judgment.
